name: agent-steer
description: Correct a running subagent without waiting for it to finish.

agent_steer_control_dir.title: Control directory
agent_steer_control_dir.description: Directory that holds <agent-name>.md steer files. Leave it empty for ~/.claude/agent-control. A directory outside ~/.claude is safer if you keep ~/.claude in version control.

agent_steer_max_age_minutes.title: Staleness cutoff, in minutes
agent_steer_max_age_minutes.description: Ignore a control file older than this. Raise it for background agents that run for days, lower it if you leave control files behind.

agent_steer_max_chars.title: Maximum steer characters
agent_steer_max_chars.description: Truncate a steer longer than this. Claude Code caps hook output at 10,000 characters, and the wrapper prose counts toward that cap.
